summary: Smith+Nephew plc, via Form 6-K, announced a cash tender offer to purchase up to $250 million of its outstanding 2.032% Senior Notes due 2030, with $900 million outstanding. Pricing uses a fixed spread of 55 basis points over the 4.375% U.S. Treasury due 2031. The offer is conditioned on a concurrent notes offering of new 2036 senior notes, with proceeds funding repurchases. Accepted notes will be canceled. BofA Securities serves as dealer manager. Investors tendering may receive allocation preference in the concurrent offering. Watch for financing condition satisfaction and potential tender oversubscription.
